title: Four financial surfaces with no numeric figure of any kind in OxFunc
status_plain: TBILLEQ, TBILLPRICE, DOLLARDE and DAYS360 have NO numeric comparison count anywhere in OxFunc. Searching the whole documentation tree returns only contract statements, inventory rows and localisation tables for them. What does exist is structural: all four appear in BUG-FUNC-028's candidate-surface list, meaning each showed a structural mismatch on at least one probe with the local outcome confirmed genuine -- a named membership, not a scored count. Their absence from any counted record is itself the finding, because these are exactly the surfaces most likely to be silently credited with a neighbour's number: TBILLEQ and TBILLPRICE sit in the same Treasury-bill lane as TBILLYIELD, whose 2,156 of 2,156 belongs to TBILLYIELD alone, and DAYS360 is a date-and-time surface that is only adjacent to this domain through day counts.
